Nanjing | Along the Qinhuai River After Snowfall
Nanjing's beauty extends beyond autumn and spring.
When snow blankets the city in winter, it feels as though you're stepping back into the Jinling of dreams...
The Confucius Temple by the Qinhuai River after snowfall resembles a fairyland, each scene like a brushstroke in an ink painting.
Auspicious snow welcomes spring's return, ushering in a new year as poetic and picturesque as ever!
